text:
Dave (PM): quick thread on burst leasing UI + API surface for Dedicated pools. customers keep asking for short burst guarantees w/ clear billing. proposing a "burst_lease" primitive. reactions? :thinking: 

Rina (Product Ops): love the primitive idea. needs clear UX: request, approval (auto/managed), duration, cooldown, and visibility. show remaining lease time in Console.

Priya (Billing): billing rules matter. two options: 1) prorated burst price for lease duration OR 2) bucketed prepaid credits consumed when leased. prefer (1) for simplicity. need invoice label and CSV export field `burst_lease_charge`.

Mark (Legal): add short paragraph in TOS about opportunistic capacity vs leased capacity. leased capacity must be clearly defined in SLA addendum. also require customer-initiated opt-in.

Evan (Runtime): impl notes: lease implies reservation of N slots or X tokens for duration. must map to existing autoscaler reservation layer. we can implement as ephemeral reservation objects with TTL. preemption semantics: leased capacity cannot be backfilled. eviction on misbehavior -> revoke lease and credit back unused time.

Nora (SRE): monitoring: add "Active Leases", "Lease Violations", "Lease Eviction Rate", and lease impact on pool headroom. alert if active_leases > planned_capacity_pct for >10m.

Dave (PM): API sketch (draft):
```
POST /pools/:id/leases
{
  "tenant_id": "acct_123",
  "units": 1000,           # tokens/sec or token budget
  "duration_seconds": 3600,
  "max_burst_multiplier": 2.5,
  "price_model": "prorated"
}

Response 201 -> { "lease_id": "lease_abc", "expires_at": 1680000000 }
```

Rina (Product Ops): Console UX: request button on pool page, modal with estimated cost, impact spinner (what SLOs might be affected), approve / request change flow. show historical lease usage under Billing tab.

Priya (Billing): add API: GET /pools/:id/leases?status=active for export. add `lease_applied_to_invoice` boolean on usage rows.

Evan (Runtime): edge cases: overlapping leases from different tenants -> enforce pool-level capacity checks. propose `lease_priority` where paid lease > free burst > backfill. also we should support fractional token budget consumption so leasing is flexible.

Mark (Legal): data residency note: if lease pins to specific region, record region in lease object. ensure audit log entry for lease grant.

Nora (SRE): canary plan: enable leases in staging on a small pool, simulate 5 concurrent leases at different sizes, measure p50/p95/p99 and eviction events. threshold: p99 should not degrade >1.5x baseline.

Dave (PM): launch criteria (beta):
- API + Console request flow implemented
- billing records and invoice export for leases
- runtime reservation enforcement + TTL revocation
- pilot with 3 customers for 72h with telemetry showing <1.5x p99 degradation and no SLA misses for non-leased traffic
- legal text and opt-in confirmation

Priya (Billing): pricing suggestion: base price + tiered multiplier during lease. e.g., base $0.02/1k tokens, lease multiplier 1.5x-2.0x depending on duration. include admin override for enterprise deals.

Rina (Product Ops): customer controls: request, cancel lease, extend lease (if capacity available), view history. show lease cooldown: e.g., cannot request new lease within 30m of expiry unless approved.

Evan (Runtime): implementation owners / ETA:
- lease API + storage: Evan (3 days)
- autoscaler integration: Evan + Carlos (2 weeks)
- enforcement + metrics: Nora (1 week)

Dave (PM): biz owners:
- Priya -> billing mapping + sample invoice (2 days)
- Mark -> SLA addendum draft (2 days)
- Rina -> Console mockups + copy (3 days)

deploy-bot: staging deploy v0.1-lease-proto succeeded (build 1099). scheduled canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

Nora (SRE): ops rollback: if lease causes >5% eviction_rate or p99 > 2x baseline, auto-disable new lease grants and notify on-call.

Dave (PM): decision: greenlight prototype. keep beta narrow (3 customers). prioritize billing labels and Console visibility. we'll reconvene after canary results. thanks all :rocket:

Evan (Runtime): quick q: do we expose `lease_priority` numeric or enum? numeric gives flexibility.

Rina (Product Ops): numeric ok but cap to avoid confusion (1-100). default 50, paid leases set to >=80.

Priya (Billing): confirm: lease charges appear as separate line items with `lease_id` foreign key in CSV.

Mark (Legal): I'll add review slot for wording before pilot.

Dave (PM): noted. owners, please update respective trackers. ping @Dave if blocked.
